<thought>All measured resistances correspond exactly to a simple series chain A‑N_a1‑N_a2‑N_a3‑X1 with four resistors. By assigning R1 = 5 Ω (A‑N_a1), R2 = 10 Ω (N_a1‑N_a2), R3 = 15 Ω (N_a2‑N_a3), and R4 = 20 Ω (N_a3‑X1), every given pairwise resistance matches the sum of the appropriate series resistors. This satisfies the note that there are four resistors and provides a complete topology.</thought>
